The library-facade rule. In alipay-sdk-java 4.40.630.ALL (the version the repository pins), the DefaultAlipayClient constructor takes the sign type as an argument (RSA, RSA2 or SM2), its DefaultSigner only stores the key string, and signing runs later in execute with that sign type, so the library does not fix the algorithm; the value comes from the program's configuration. Both annotations had it as an RSA signer object.
